care.formulaArchetype: Leave-on facial oil combining coconut oil, vitamin E, sweet almond oil, olive oil and camellia seed oil, described by the manufacturer as brightening, antioxidant and firming
care.advisoryBoundary: Supports everyday hydration, antioxidant protection and a brighter-looking complexion. The exact concentrations, formula stability and clinical effect are not established, so do not present it as treatment for hyperpigmentation, melasma, acne, or another skin condition. Introduce one active at a time and pair with daytime sun protection. Stop if it burns, stings, or irritates, and seek clinician advice for changing, painful, itchy, spreading, or persistent dark marks.
